top_signals.title: Citadel Securities’ Fed Rate Hike Call Adds to Market Angst
top_signals.summary: Ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision later Wednesday, bond traders are on edge. While most expect policymakers to leave interest rates unchanged, prominent voices across Wall Street are putting their weight behind a hike in just the second meeting run by new Chairman Kevin Warsh.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
